dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar. It then uses this doxing_data to enter SEARCH AND RESCUE.
For valid safe or duress placeholders, SAR signs duress_placeholder with sar_privkey and encrypts it with
boomlet_1_identity_pubkey. Malformed placeholders are rejected before any acknowledgment is created.
